summary: Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on Sep 25, 2026, announcing a Business Combination Agreement with REDLattice, a Delaware cyber intelligence services provider. The deal involves Bold Eagle domesticating into Delaware as PubCo and merging a wholly-owned subsidiary into REDLattice, which will survive as a wholly-owned PubCo subsidiary. Both boards unanimously approved the transaction. Filing details are limited to structure and background; exact exchange ratio, valuation, and premium are not disclosed. Watch for shareholder redemption levels, regulatory approvals, and eventual proxy terms.
